headline: Aditya Khemka Submits SEBI Takeover Regulation Disclosure for Aditya Infotech Limited
sum: Aditya Khemka has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4), triggering mandatory takeover regulation compliance for Aditya Infotech Limited on the NSE.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure signals a threshold crossing event (25% or 5% additional acquisition) requiring immediate exchange filing and potential open offer triggering-critical timing and structure point for subsequent mandatory offer obligations.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to the NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, as evidenced by the NSE filing archive. Aditya Khemka's filing of this disclosure indicates a change in shareholding that meets the regulatory threshold under Regulation 31(4), which mandates disclosure of any acquisition of shares or voting rights that crosses specified thresholds. The exact quantum of shares acquired and the consideration are not disclosed in the headline but would be detailed in the full Form-A filed with the exchange.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement for acquisition of shares or voting rights crossing 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 50%, 75% or 90% thresholds; filing must be made before or within 4 trading days of crossing threshold.
Definition of 'acquirer' and 'acquisition' to determine if mandatory open offer is triggered; applies to persons acquiring 25% or more of voting shares.
Open Offer requirements: if acquisition crosses 25% threshold and is not by way of a scheme, an open offer to all shareholders at floor price must be made.
Prescribed format for disclosure of substantial acquisition; must contain details of acquirer, target, shareholding pattern, consideration and timing.
Disclosure of members' shareholding and beneficial interest; cross-ref with takeover disclosure for aggregate holdings verification.
Exemptions to mandatory open offer in case of acquisition by way of scheme approved by court or negotiated acquisition from shareholders; may apply to this transaction.

framework.ref: Stock Exchange listing rules (NSE NSELM Rules & BSE Listing Rules 2015)
framework.note: Exchange-specific disclosure requirements and timelines for taking-private/delisting if this transaction progresses to a full takeover.

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, Regulation 23 & 24
framework.note: Related party transaction disclosure if Aditya Khemka has prior connections to Aditya Infotech or its board.

conditions: Acquisition of shares or voting rights crossing SEBI Regulation 31(4) threshold
If threshold ≥25%: potential mandatory open offer obligation under Regulation 10
approvals: Potential SEBI review if open offer is triggered
Board approval of open offer (if applicable)
structure.novel: Standard regulatory disclosure milestone; unless this is a take-private attempt or a competing acquisition, the novelty lies in the specific shareholding pattern transition.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
triggers.note: Threshold crossing (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 50%, 75% or 90%) mandates immediate disclosure filing.
If acquisition equals or exceeds 25%, open offer to all shareholders becomes mandatory unless exempted.
Public company status of Aditya Infotech triggers continuous disclosure obligations and exchange review.
